title: Uninstall has two supervisor-service removal paths after the 0.4.4 sync
body: src/cli/uninstall.ts runs v0.5's service-manager unregister for fleet-supervisor and then main's cleanupSupervisorService (ownership-checked, also catches the SKILL.md recipe units). Both are idempotent, so behaviour is correct, but the two paths should be unified into one.
reason: found during the main -> v0.5_dashboard sync

title: Cycle-repair scenario fixture cannot be re-recorded with bd 1.3.0
body: test/mock-sprint-parent-child-blocks-cycle-repair.test.mjs builds a parent+blocks cycle with 'bd dep add', which bd 1.3.0 (the CI pin) refuses ('cannot be blocked by its descendant'). Its replay recording still passes, but it can never be refreshed in record mode. Build the cycle another way (or recognise the cycle can no longer arise with 1.3.0 and retire the repair path).
reason: found during the main -> v0.5_dashboard sync

title: vcs-auth-pr-self-heal no-leak assertion can never fail
body: packages/apra-fleet-se/test/vcs-auth-pr-self-heal.test.mjs asserts the token 'mock-vcs-module-pr-token' never reaches logs, but it delegates vcs_credential_exec to defaultMockCallTool in test/helpers/mock-sprint-harness.mjs, which injects its own MOCK_VCS_CREDENTIAL_TOKENS ('mock-vcs-module-token'). The asserted token is never in play, so the leak check is vacuous. Assert on the token the simulator actually injects.
reason: found during the v0.5 KB bible truth pass
